meta.title: {product} | AI assistants for the employee journey
meta.description: An ecosystem of assistants that supports employees and HR from the first day to career growth, answering from your approved company documents with sources.

hero.title: AI assistants for every stage of the employee journey.
hero.lead: {product} is an ecosystem of assistants that support employees and HR from the first day to career growth, using your approved company knowledge.

preview.label: Onboarding Agent answer example
preview.question: How do I request annual leave?
preview.answer: Submit annual leave through the HR Portal at least 3 working days before the planned date. The request then goes to your manager for approval.
preview.notFound: When the approved documents do not cover a question, the assistant does not guess. It forwards the question to HR.

problem.title: Employee experience still runs on scattered tools
items: New hires get the same pile of documents, with no clear sense of which ones apply to their role.
HR answers the same leave, payroll and policy questions with every intake.
Onboarding, learning and career processes run in separate systems that do not talk to each other.
Managers often notice what their team needs only after a problem has grown.

trust.title: What it does and what it does not
does: Answer from approved documents and cite the source
Say so when the information is missing and pass the question to HR
Show plans to employees only after HR approval
Use synthetic or anonymised data during testing and pilots
doesNot: Monitor employees or read their messages and email
Score performance, stress or attrition risk
Make hiring, promotion, pay or disciplinary decisions
trust.compliance: Designed in line with KVKK and GDPR principles, with the EU AI Act requirements in mind.
trust.lead: {product} assistants inform and guide. They do not make decisions, monitor employees or score them.

team.title: Team
team.lead: {company}, in collaboration with AOSB Technopark and Antalya Bilim University.

contact.title: Join the pilot programme
contact.body: One department, 15-30 new or recent hires and your handbook are enough. We set up the assistant and prepare the documents together.

login.title: Sign-in is by invitation
login.body: {product} is currently open to users invited by companies in the pilot programme. Your HR team creates your account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: This site uses no cookies and collects no personal data from visitors. Details you send from your email client for a pilot request are used only to answer that request.

app.label: Onboarding Agent app preview
app.title: AI Assistant
app.subtitle: Answers come from approved company documents.
app.q2: Has the evening shuttle route changed?
app.a2: I could not find current information on this in the approved documents. I have passed your question to HR, and you will see the answer here.

features.title: One platform, shared principles
features.lead: Each assistant focuses on its own job. All of them share the same knowledge base, the same rules and the same HR control.

grounded.title: Every answer has a source
grounded.body: The assistants answer only from company documents HR has approved, and they show the source. If the information is missing, they do not guess. They pass the question to HR.

plan.title: One shared employee journey
plan.body: The assistants work on the same journey plan. From the first 90 days to career growth, employees see their next step on one screen.

hr.title: HR always has the final say
hr.body: HR approves documents and templates, reviews the plans assistants prepare and decides which assistant is introduced and when.

agents.name: Onboarding Agent
agents.short: Guidance, cited answers and a task plan for the first 90 days.
agents.tagline: Runs a new hire's first 90 days with your company's own knowledge.

caps.title: Answers with sources
caps.body: Answers from approved documents and shows the source. If the information is missing, it does not guess. It passes the question to HR.

caps.title: A 30/60/90-day plan per role
caps.body: Prepares tasks, documents and dates from the role profile. The plan reaches the employee after HR approval.

caps.title: Missions and progress
caps.body: Employees see their next task and where they stand on one screen.

audience: Managers who see progress where HR allows it

agents.name: HR Assistant
agents.short: Cited answers to routine HR questions.
agents.tagline: Answers leave, payroll and policy questions from sources HR has approved.

caps.title: Self-service answers
caps.body: Employees can ask about leave, benefits and policies at any time of day.

caps.title: Repeated question insights
caps.body: HR sees which questions come up again and which documents are missing or unclear.

caps.title: Request routing
caps.body: Questions the assistant cannot answer, or sensitive ones, go to the right HR person.

agents.name: Learning Assistant
agents.tagline: Offers step-by-step learning paths for each role that keep the information load manageable.

caps.title: Small daily steps
caps.body: Information arrives in small, meaningful pieces each day instead of all at once.

caps.title: Role-based content
caps.body: Training material is ordered by the employee's role and experience.

caps.title: Optional badges
caps.body: Completed tasks become visible through an optional badge and progress system.

audience: New employees and people changing roles

agents.name: Culture Assistant
agents.tagline: Helps employees from other countries settle into the company, the team and a new country.

caps.title: Country guide
caps.body: Provides information on work permits, social security and daily life from approved sources.

caps.title: Culture missions
caps.body: Introduces the company's unwritten rules through small missions instead of long lists.

caps.title: Buddy matching
caps.body: With HR approval, introduces new hires to an experienced colleague.

agents.name: Manager Assistant
agents.tagline: Gives managers aggregated, anonymous summaries of their team's onboarding and development.

caps.title: Weekly team summary
caps.body: Completed tasks, open questions and upcoming steps are summarised at team level.

caps.title: 1:1 preparation
caps.body: Suggests a meeting agenda from goals the employee has chosen to share.

caps.title: Workload visibility
caps.body: Task distribution is shown at team level. No individual monitoring.

agents.name: Wellbeing Assistant
agents.tagline: Brings together the wellbeing resources and support channels employees can reach on their own terms.

caps.title: Voluntary check-in
caps.body: If they choose, employees answer a short check-in and get pointed to relevant resources.

caps.title: Support channels
caps.body: Psychological support, flexible work and leave options are visible in one place.

caps.title: Life transitions
caps.body: Offers approved guides for periods such as returning from parental leave.

agents.name: Crisis Assistant
agents.tagline: Delivers current procedures to employees during emergencies and shifts to remote work.

caps.title: Procedure guide
caps.body: Answers emergency and business continuity questions instantly from approved sources.

caps.title: Remote start
caps.body: Provides remote first steps for new hires who cannot come to the office.

caps.title: Support routing
caps.body: Directs employees to the relevant teams and support channels.

agents.name: Career Assistant
agents.tagline: Helps employees clarify career goals and prepare for development conversations.

caps.title: Goal setting
caps.body: Employees record their career goals and interests in a structured way.

caps.title: Growth opportunities
caps.body: Shows internal training and role opportunities that match their goals.

caps.title: Conversation prep
caps.body: Prepares a summary from the employee's own notes before a career conversation.
